# Job-Applications — agent guide

Fleet-wide policy (Caveman, security/JIT secrets, identity matrix, domain boundaries, 3-layer network,
5-phase lifecycle, LLM/workflow rules) is loaded **globally** from `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` / `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`.
Do not copy it into this repo. Source of truth: `fleet-sdk` → `fleet_sdk/governance/templates/policy/`.
